description: This file contains utility functions for extracting parameters related to the Litellm language model, including fetching model info from metadata and assembling a dictionary of parameters for Litellm API calls.

methods.name: _get_base_model_from_litellm_call_metadata
methods.description: Extracts the 'base_model' string from given metadata dictionary, if available.

methods.name: get_litellm_params
methods.description: Constructs and returns a dictionary of parameters for Litellm API calls based on provided arguments and metadata.
